39894-roman-sepulchral-inscriptions-thei.creator: Unknown
39894-roman-sepulchral-inscriptions-thei.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The memorials of the dead hold a remarkable place among the materials of history. The very existence of nations is in many cases attested only by their sepulcral monuments, which serve to trace the course of their migrations, and yield us a scanty knowledge of their usages, and of the state of civilization among them.

arxiv-1610-00525.title: Linearity defect of the residue field of short local rings Thanks: This research was in part supported by a grant from IPM (No. 94130028). This work was also supported by the Iran National Science Foundation (INSF) grant No. 95001343
arxiv-1610-00525.creator: Rasoul Ahangari Maleki
arxiv-1610-00525.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Rasoul Ahangari Maleki. Let ( R , 𝔪 , k ) (R,\mathfrak{m},k) be a Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} and residue field k k . The linearity defect of a finitely generated R R -module M M , which is denoted ld R ⁡ ( M ) \operatorname{ld}_{R}(M) , is a numerical measure of how far M M is from having linear resolution. We study the linearity defect of the residue field.

arxiv-1911-04813.title: Measurement of the Z ( → ℓ + ℓ − ) γ Z(\to\!\ell^{+}\ell^{-})\gamma production cross-section in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\penalty\ \text{Te\kern-1.00006ptV} with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1911-04813.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1911-04813.description: Abstract The production of a prompt photon in association with a Z Z boson is studied in proton–proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy s = \sqrt{s}= 13 TeV . The analysis uses a data sample with an integrated luminosity of 139 fb -1 collected by the ATLAS detector at the LHC from 2015 to 2018.

arxiv-2006-02662.title: Exploiting the Transferability of Deep Learning Systems Across Multi-modal Retinal Scans for Extracting Retinopathy Lesions Thanks: This work is supported by a research fund from Khalifa University: Ref: CIRA-2019-047.
arxiv-2006-02662.creator: Taimur Hassan † ⋄ , Muhammad Usman Akram ⋄ , Naoufel Werghi †
arxiv-2006-02662.description: Abstract Retinal lesions play a vital role in the accurate classification of retinal abnormalities. Many researchers have proposed deep lesion-aware screening systems that analyze and grade the progression of retinopathy. However, to the best of our knowledge, no literature exploits the tendency of these systems to generalize across multiple scanner specifications and multi-modal imagery.

arxiv-2012-11962.title: Vortex Flows and Streamline Topology in Curved Biological Membranes
arxiv-2012-11962.creator: R. Samanta, N. Oppenheimer
arxiv-2012-11962.description: Abstract When considering flows in biological membranes, they are usually treated as flat, though more often than not, they are curved surfaces, even extremely curved, as in the case of the endoplasmic reticulum. Here, we study the topological effects of curvature on flows in membranes.

arxiv-2208-01766.title: Eccentricity estimation for five binary black hole mergers with higher-order gravitational wave modes
arxiv-2208-01766.creator: H. L. Iglesias, J. Lange, I. Bartos, S. Bhaumik, R. Gamba, V. Gayathri, A. Jan, R. Nowicki, R. O’Shaughnessy, D. M. Shoemaker, R. Venkataramanan, K. Wagner
arxiv-2208-01766.description: Abstract The detection of orbital eccentricity for a binary black hole system via gravitational waves is a key signature to distinguish between the possible binary origins. The identification of eccentricity has been difficult so far due to the limited availability of eccentric gravitational waveforms over the full range of black hole masses and eccentricities.

arxiv-2309-13259.title: EMelodyGen: Emotion-Conditioned Melody Generation in ABC Notation with the Musical Feature Template
arxiv-2309-13259.creator: Monan Zhou, Xiaobing Li, Feng Yu, Wei Li
arxiv-2309-13259.description: Abstract The EMelodyGen system focuses on emotional melody generation in ABC notation controlled by the musical feature template. Owing to the scarcity of well-structured and emotionally labeled sheet music, we designed a template for controlling emotional melody generation by statistical correlations between musical features and emotion labels derived from small-scale emotional symbolic music datasets and music psychology conclusions.

arxiv-2312-08152.title: Key4hep: Progress Report on Integrations
arxiv-2312-08152.creator: \firstname Erica \lastname Brondolin, \firstname Juan Miguel \lastname Carceller, \firstname Wouter \lastname Deconinck, \firstname Wenxing \lastname Fang, \firstname Brieuc \lastname Francois, \firstname Frank-Dieter \lastname Gaede, \firstname Gerardo \lastname Ganis, \firstname Benedikt \lastname
arxiv-2312-08152.description: Abstract Detector studies for future experiments rely on advanced software tools to estimate performance and optimize their design and technology choices. The Key4hep project provides a flexible turnkey solution for the full experiment life-cycle based on established community tools such as ROOT, Geant4, DD4hep, Gaudi, podio and spack.

arxiv-2404-09661.title: Reconstructing Curves from Sparse Samples on Riemannian Manifolds
arxiv-2404-09661.creator: D. Marin 1 , F. Maggioli 2 , S. Melzi 2 , S. Ohrhallinger 1 , and M. Wimmer 1 1 TU Wien, Vienna, Austria 2 University of Milano-Bicocca, Milan, Italy
arxiv-2404-09661.description: Abstract Reconstructing 2D curves from sample points has long been a critical challenge in computer graphics, finding essential applications in vector graphics. The design and editing of curves on surfaces has only recently begun to receive attention, primarily relying on human assistance, and where not, limited by very strict sampling conditions.

arxiv-2504-12596.title: Higher-Order Mean-Motion Resonances Can Form in Type-I Disk Migration Journal: APJ REBOUND ( Rein & Liu 2012 ) , REBOUNDx ( Tamayo et al. 2020 ) , celmech ( Hadden & Tamayo 2022 ) , forecaster ( Chen & Kipping 2017 ) , pandas ( Pandas Development Team 2020 ; Wes McKinney 2010 ) , numpy ( Harris et a
arxiv-2504-12596.creator: Finnegan M. Keller, Fei Dai, Wenrui Xu
arxiv-2504-12596.description: Abstract Type-I disk migration can form a chain of planets engaged in first-order mean-motion resonances (MMRs) parked at the disk inner edge. However, while second- or even third-order resonances were deemed unlikely due to their weaker strength, they have been observed in some planetary systems (e.g. TOI-178 bc: 5:3, TOI-1136 ef: 7:5, TRAPPIST-1 bcd: 8:5-5:3).

pmc-11431209.title: Antioxidant Peptides and Protein Hydrolysates from Tilapia: Cellular and In Vivo Evidences for Human Health Benefits
pmc-11431209.creator: Wen-Jie Ng, Fai-Chu Wong, Fazilah Abd Manan, Yit-Lai Chow, Ai-Lin Ooi, Mei-Kying Ong, Xuewu Zhang, Tsun-Thai Chai, Pascal Degraeve
pmc-11431209.description: Antioxidant peptides derived from aquatic organisms have attracted tremendous research interest due to their potential applications in human health. Tilapia is one of the most widely farmed aquaculture species globally. The current understanding of tilapia-derived antioxidant peptides is gradually expanding.

pmc-12560373.title: Effects of chronic nicotine administration on behavioral parameters and Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase mRNA expression in the brains of male Swiss Albino mice exposed to chronic stress during adolescence
pmc-12560373.creator: NourAllah Ahmed, Mohamed Ahmed, Assem Ragab, Mohamed Kamal, Abdullrahman Elsayed, Moustafa Sayed
pmc-12560373.description: BackgroundStress during adolescence leads to the development of major stress-related diseases. The use of psychoactive substances and most psychiatric disorders have been linked to cigarette smoking during adolescence. Na+/K + ATPase isoforms are related to memory formation, stress activity and psychological disorders. Moreover, nicotine downregulates Na+/K + ATPase α2 isoform in rats’ brains.

pmc-12599360.title: It’s time to act: Understanding and combating Vibrio vulnificus
pmc-12599360.creator: Chao Li, Gang Li, Ming Li
pmc-12599360.description: Vibrio vulnificus is a highly pathogenic marine bacterium that can cause life-threatening conditions such as septicemia and necrotizing fasciitis; in medically fragile individuals, mortality rates can exceed 50%. Its virulence factors, including the MARTX toxin and hemolysin VvhA, function to disrupt host cells, evade immune responses, and facilitate bacterial dissemination. Climate warming has dramatically expanded the geographic range of V.

pmc-12652096.title: Neurodegeneration Through the Lens of Bioinformatics Approaches: Computational Mechanisms of Protein Misfolding
pmc-12652096.creator: Mubashir Hassan, Saba Shahzadi, Ahmed A Moustafa, Andrzej Kloczkowski, Claudia Ricci
pmc-12652096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Protein and peptide aggregation has become a prominent focus in biomedical research due to its critical role in the development of neurodegenerative diseases (NDs) and its relevance to industrial applications. Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), Huntington’s disease (HD), and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) are closely associated with abnormal aggregation processes, highlighting the need for a deeper understanding of their molecular mechanisms.

pmc-13402601.title: Developing aluminum molecular plating for neutron-induced reaction target fabrication
pmc-13402601.creator: Scott D Essenmacher, Sean A Kuvin, Hye Young Lee, Khachatur Manukyan, Veronika Mocko
pmc-13402601.description: Al is an important radionuclide for research on stellar nucleosynthesis in the Galaxy and the environment of the early solar system. Computational simulations involving the production and destruction of Al in stellar nucleosynthesis and supernovae rely on accurate nuclear reaction network data.

pmc-13430918.title: Nutritional status and attitudes toward overweight and obesity among health-science students in Vietnam
pmc-13430918.creator: Ngo Xuan Khoa, Vo Tien Huy, Nguyen Xuan Tuan, Ngo Thi Tam, Tran Linh Cham, Hoang Duc Hanh
pmc-13430918.description: ObjectiveTo assess nutritional status across different health-professional disciplines and to examine attitudes toward overweight and obesity and their associated factors among undergraduate health-science students in Vietnam.MethodsA cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 764 undergraduate students from medicine, nursing, pharmacy, and other health programs at two universities in Hanoi. Stratified random sampling ensured representation by major and academic year.

pmc-13441640.title: Prevalence and Pattern of Congenital Anomalies Among Deliveries and Pregnancy Terminations at a Tertiary Care Center
pmc-13441640.creator: Ravindra S Pukale, Greeshma V R
pmc-13441640.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction: Congenital anomalies are an important cause of perinatal morbidity and mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Data on their prevalence and pattern remain limited because many studies exclude stillbirths and medically terminated pregnancies.

Jonathan), beetroot (Beta vulgaris L.), carrot (Daucus carota L.), and plum (Prunus domestica L.) pomaces are among the major by-products generated by the juice processing industry in Europe, particularly in producing countries such as Poland, Germany, Spain, and Romania.
